name: Plex Media Server
description: Organize and stream your personal video, music, and photo collections to any screen.
docker_compose:
version: '3.8'
services:
  plex:
    image: linuxserver/plex:latest
    container_name: plex
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - VERSION=docker
    volumes:
      - /opt/naybinho/appdata/plex:/config
      - /data/media:/media
    restart: unless-stopped

docker_compose:
version: '3.8'
services:
  zigbee2mqtt:
    image: koenkk/zigbee2mqtt:latest
    container_name: zigbee2mqtt
    ports:
      - 8099:8080
    volumes:
      - /opt/naybinho/appdata/zigbee2mqtt:/app/data
      - /dev/ttyACM0:/dev/ttyACM0
    restart: unless-stopped

name: Z-Wave JS UI
description: Full featured Z-Wave Control Panel and MQTT Gateway.
docker_compose:
version: '3.8'
services:
  zwave:
    image: zwavejs/zwave-js-ui:latest
    container_name: zwave-js-ui
    ports:
      - 8092:8091
      - 3004:3000
    volumes:
      - /opt/naybinho/appdata/zwave:/usr/src/app/store
    restart: unless-stopped

name: Speedtest Tracker
description: Self-hosted internet performance tracker using Ookla speedtest CLI.
docker_compose:
version: '3.8'
services:
  speedtest:
    image: alexjustesen/speedtest-tracker:latest
    container_name: speedtest-tracker
    ports:
      - 8085:80
    volumes:
      - /opt/naybinho/appdata/speedtest:/config
    restart: unless-stopped

name: Scrutiny
description: Hard Drive S.M.A.R.T Monitoring, web dashboard, and notifications.
docker_compose:
version: '3.8'
services:
  scrutiny:
    image: ghcr.io/analogj/scrutiny:master-omnibus
    container_name: scrutiny
    cap_add:
      - SYS_RAWIO
    ports:
      - 8093:8080
    volumes:
      - /run/udev:/run/udev:ro
      - /opt/naybinho/appdata/scrutiny/config:/opt/scrutiny/config
      - /opt/naybinho/appdata/scrutiny/influxdb:/opt/scrutiny/influxdb
    restart: unless-stopped

name: Netdata
description: High-fidelity real-time system performance and health monitoring.
docker_compose:
version: '3.8'
services:
  netdata:
    image: netdata/netdata:latest
    container_name: netdata
    ports:
      - 19999:19999
    cap_add:
      - SYS_PTRACE
    security_opt:
      - apparmor:unconfined
    volumes:
      - /proc:/host/proc:ro
      - /sys:/host/sys:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
    restart: unless-stopped

name: Dozzle

name: MinIO S3
description: High Performance Object Storage compatible with Amazon S3 API.
docker_compose:
version: '3.8'
services:
  minio:
    image: minio/minio:latest
    container_name: minio
    command: server /data --console-address ':9001'
    ports:
      - 9000:9000
      - 9001:9001
    environment:
      - MINIO_ROOT_USER=admin
      - MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=naybinhonas
    volumes:
      - /data/minio:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
